notes.title: Ultima Chess Devlog: 0.4 - 0.6
notes.content:
Hello, hope you're doing well today, so let's straight tight to the point;)

Character Selection
We have almost done the selection of characters for all 12 faction and parallel working on their animations and effects (appearance, disappearance, combat).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/ae22347c4fb937beef96216200ca64e8f577e846.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/ff334b33f1e2da7bdefdd7c2f4797c7a4d3eb2b2.jpg

Ancient Knight Chess Piece
The knight in the ancient faction will be in the form of a drone and he will have a cool animation - when attacking a figure, he will release a beam and then do a backflip. Soon I will show the animation, how it will look.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/e5a2e1ace3e63c7b06994bd106ea17ac1ed5df76.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/c2bc7dae313fcd171c34209f7a7fbbb9ae4522e6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/1c4f99677d06efa617c023082d20ffbff7d7feac.jpg

Hair Physics Adjustment
This update is purely aimed at tweaking the hair animation, specifically the ponytail. We have adjusted its physics and collisions with clothing, so that now it animate correctly.
[previewyoutube=W5N0-75cCg8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ultima Chess Devlog: 0.1 - 0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone, today we will talk about what chess AI we will use, the Ancient environment, and chess movements mechanics.

Stockfish & The C++ Chess AI
We will integrate Stockfish for the PC and SteamVR versions. For Meta, we will use the C++ Chess AI with 1500 Elo. So far, Stockfish has not been implemented on a Meta platform, and it is technically difficult to run Stockfish on Android, so we will use this AI for now.

Ancient Environment
We completed blocking and art desing first of twelve location. Regard to its name, it's home location for Ancient faction. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/dabf6884831302a6259d970b3ab1b4c38ebba57b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/dabf6884831302a6259d970b3ab1b4c38ebba57b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/671d84ec309b32f5574484365841813e1f00a9c2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/49827cb1e6684ca5f58f095a1b033b076c75c205.jpg

Chess Movements Mechanics
We've also finalized the implementation of chess moves for the characters, so now they will make the appropriate moves, according to the chess pieces. We implemented the mechanics on Unreal Engine 5 via Blueprint. This is what it looks like:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556543/c0c25cf58a7afd3e0b77ef9fe3ba7b6071806ae2.jpg

Also feel free to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/v228Pg4xAc


It's all for today, see you soon:)
